title: FATHER GOD, LET EVERY BATTLE OF TODAY END IN TESTIMONY!!
text: Glory to God. Hallelujah. I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are right now. Whether you are in your living room, in your car, at your workplace, I want you to understand that we are not gathering here by accident. The Holy Spirit has orchestrated this moment. There is a prophetic atmosphere that is being released. Even as we begin to minister, and I decree in the name of Jesus that every word that proceeds from this altar will not return void. It will accomplish that which God has sent it to do in your life. Now I want you to say this with me. Father, let every battle of today end in testimony. Say it again. Father, let every battle of today end in testimony. You see, when you understand the prophetic implications of this prayer, you will realize that we are not just making empty declarations. We are calling forth the governmental authority of heaven to intervene in the affairs of time. The battles that you are facing today and I'm talking about battles in your finances, battles in your health, battles in your marriage, battles in your ministry, battles against delay and stagnation. These battles did not just happen. They were orchestrated by forces in the realm of darkness that understand the significance of your destiny. But I have come to announce to you today that Jesus Christ, the captain of the host, the Lord of hosts, the man of war, whose name is Jehovah, has already given you the victory. The question is not whether you will win. The question is whether you understand the weapons that have been made available to you. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 10:4, "For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." You see, many believers are fighting spiritual battles with physical weapons. They are trying to fight demonic orchestrations with human intelligence. They are trying to fight spiritual wickedness in high places with psychological strategies. But I have come to tell you that there is a dimension of warfare that you must enter if you want your battles to end in testimony. When David went to fight Goliath, everyone saw a physical battle. Saul tried to give him physical armor, but David understood something that many believers have not understood. He said, "You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin, but I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied." You see, David relocated the battle from the physical realm to the spiritual realm. And when you can relocate your battle from the realm of human effort to the realm of divine intervention, I prophesy that your testimony will be inevitable. Now lift your right hand. I want to pray a prophetic prayer over your life. Say, "Father, in the name of Jesus, I ask that you will open my eyes to see beyond the physical manifestations of my battles. Let me see the spiritual orchestrations. Give me the wisdom to know how to fight. Give me the faith to believe that victory is possible. And father I ask that as I engage in this prayer today every battle whether it is in my health in my finances in my relationships in my ministry let it end in testimony in Jesus's mighty name. Now can I share something with you? When God wants to give you a testimony he will first permit you to face a test. You cannot have a testimony without a test. The very word testimony comes from the root word test. And so when you are going through difficult situations, when you are facing battles that seem overwhelming, you must understand that God is setting you up for a testimony that will glorify his name. Look at what happened to the three Hebrew boys, Shedrach, Meshach, and Abednego. The battle they faced was not just about refusing to bow to an idol. It was about establishing a testimony that would demonstrate the supremacy of God over the gods of Babylon. When they were thrown into the fire, they were not thrown there to be destroyed. They were thrown there to produce a testimony. And the Bible says that when they came out of that fire, they didn't even smell of smoke. That is the kind of testimony God wants to give you. He wants you to come out of your battles without even the scent of what you went through. I prophesy over your life, you will not carry the scars of your battles. You will carry the glory of your victories. You will not tell stories of pain. You will tell stories of divine intervention. You will not rehearse defeat. You will announce triumph in Jesus name. Now there are certain spiritual principles that govern how battles end in testimony. And I want to share them with you. The first principle is this. You must understand the source of the battle. Not every battle is from the devil and not every battle is allowed by God. Some battles are self-inflicted because of disobedience. Some battles are permitted by God because he's preparing you for a higher level of glory. And some battles are direct attacks from the kingdom of darkness because they know what God is about to do in your life. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." You see many people are fighting the wrong enemy. They are fighting their spouse when the real enemy is a spirit of division. They are fighting their boss when the real enemy is a spirit of limitation. They are fighting their pastor when the real enemy is a spirit of offense. When you misidentify your enemy, you will waste your ammunition. But when you correctly identify the spiritual forces orchestrating your battles, you can then address them with precision. And this is what I want you to understand. God is not confused about your battle. He knows exactly what you are facing. He knows the name of every demon that has been assigned against your life. He knows every covenant that has been established in the second heaven to frustrate your destiny. And he has given you the authority to dismantle every one of them. Can I tell you about a woman in the Bible? Her name was Hannah. She faced a battle of barness. Now that battle was not just physical. It was spiritual. The Bible says that the Lord had shut up her womb. But Hannah understood something. She understood that weeping and complaining would not change her situation. She had to engage in spiritual warfare. She went to the house of God. And the Bible says she prayed with such intensity that the priest thought she was drunk. She was not just praying. She was contending. She was wrestling in the spirit realm. And this is what I want you to understand. Your breakthrough will not come through passive prayer. It will come through militant intercession. It will come when you take hold of the horns of the altar and refuse to let go until God answers. It will come when you enter into that dimension of spiritual violence that the Bible talks about when it says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. Now lift your hands again. I want to pray for you. Say, "Father, I thank you because you have equipped me for warfare. You have given me the weapons of my warfare. You have given me the name of Jesus. You have given me the blood of Jesus. You have given me the word of God. You have given me the Holy Spirit. And Father, I decree that from this moment, I will no longer fight from a position of weakness. I will fight from a position of victory. I will not beg the devil to leave me alone. I will command him to go. I will not negotiate with demons. I will evict them in Jesus mighty name. The second principle you must understand is this. Your testimony is connected to your obedience. You see, God will never give you a testimony through disobedience. When God told Joshua, "Be strong and of good courage," he followed it with instructions. He said, "Only observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded thee. Turn not from me to the right hand or to the left that thou mayest prosper whethersoever thou goest." You cannot prosper in the way that God has destined for you if you are operating outside of his instructions. Some of you are in battles today because you are fighting battles that God never told you to fight. You are in relationships that God never ordained. You are in business partnerships that God never blessed. You are pursuing dreams that God never planted in your spirit. And now you are wondering why there is so much turbulence. But I have good news for you. God is a merciful God. If you will repent today, and I'm not talking about religious repentance. I'm talking about genuine turning away from parts that God did not ordain. If you will come back to the altar and say, "Lord, I surrender my will to your will. I surrender my plans to your plans." I prophesy that God will not only deliver you from the battle, but he will turn your mess into a message. He will turn your test into a testimony. Look at what happened to Jonah. Jonah was in a battle inside the belly of a fish because of disobedience. But when he repented, when he said, "Those that observe lying vanities, forsake their own mercy, but I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving," God commanded the fish to vomit him on dry land. And Jonah went on to become the instrument through which an entire city was saved. So your current battle does not disqualify you from your future testimony. Your current situation does not determine your final destination. Where you are today is not where you will end. I speak prophetically over your life. God is about to command your deliverance. He's about to release you from every cage. He's about to break every chain. He's about to open doors that have been shut. He's about to restore what has been stolen. And when he does, you will have a testimony that will cause nations to turn to him. Now the third principle is this. You must engage the power of declaration. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your tongue is a weapon. Your words carry creative power. When you speak, you are not just making noise. You are releasing spiritual forces into the atmosphere. This is why the devil fights so hard to control what comes out of your mouth. He wants you to speak defeat. He wants you to speak sickness. He wants you to speak poverty. He wants you to speak death because he understands that the moment you begin to speak what God has said, his kingdom begins to crumble. When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, he didn't argue with the devil. He didn't try to explain theology to the devil. He simply said, "It is written." He released the word of God from his mouth and the devil had no choice but to flee. And this is what I want you to understand. The word of God in your mouth is as powerful as it is in God's mouth. When you declare what God has said, heaven moves to enforce it. So I want you to begin to declare over your life right now. Say, "Every battle of today will end in testimony. Every attack against my life is defeated. Every scheme of the enemy is dismantled. Every covenant with darkness is broken. Every course is reversed. Every delay is terminated. Every sickness is healed. Every door that has been shut is opening. Every resource that has been withheld is released. Every relationship that has been damaged is restored. I am coming out of this battle with a testimony that will glorify God in Jesus name. You see, when you speak like this, you are not trying to convince yourself. You are releasing the governmental authority of heaven. You are enforcing the victory that Jesus already won on the cross. The battle is not about whether Jesus has won. The battle is about whether you will enforce his victory in your life. Now let me show you something in the scriptures. When Israel was surrounded by three enemy armies, the Moabites, the Ammonites, and the inhabitants of Mount Sea, they were in a battle that was humanly impossible to win. But the Bible says that Jehoshaphat inquired of the Lord. And the prophet came and said, "Thus says the Lord unto you, be not afraid, nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but God's." Now watch what happened. Jehoshaphat appointed singers to go before the army. Can you imagine that? You are going to war and you are sending singers ahead of your soldiers. But the Bible says that when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushes against their enemies and they destroyed one another. Israel didn't even have to fight. They just had to praise. This is the dimension of warfare that many believers have not understood. There is a level of spiritual conflict where your weapon is worship. There is a level where your weapon is praise. There is a level where your weapon is thanksgiving. When you begin to praise God in the midst of your battle, you are not being religious. You are activating a spiritual law that causes confusion in the camp of your enemies. Can I pray for somebody? Lift your right hand. Say, "Father, I thank you because you are the Lord of hosts. You are the God of angel armies. You are the one who fights for me. And Father, even as I lift my voice in praise today, I decree that confusion will enter into the camp of my enemies. Let every force that has gathered against me begin to fight against itself. Let every demon that has been assigned to my life turn against the one that sent it. Let every strategy of darkness backfire. Let every arrow that has been released return to send sevenfold in Jesus mighty name. Now there is something else I want you to understand. Your testimony is not just for you. Your testimony is for generations. When God delivers you, when he turns your battle into testimony, it establishes a spiritual precedent that affects your children and your children's children. This is why you cannot afford to give up. This is why you cannot afford to surrender. This is why you must fight until you see the manifestation of your victory. Look at what happened with Abraham. When Abraham offered Isaac on the altar in obedience to God, something happened in the spiritual realm. The Bible says that the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said, "By myself I have sworn, says the Lord, because you have done this thing and have not withheld your son, your only son, blessing, I will bless you and multiplying, I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heaven and as the sun which is on the seashore. And your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies." You see, Abraham's obedience in that battle didn't just affect him. It affected every generation that came after him. And this is what I want to prophesy over your life. The battle you are winning today is not just for you. It is for your children. It is for your grandchildren. It is for generations yet unborn. When you stand firm in this battle, when you refuse to compromise, when you hold on to your faith, you are establishing a spiritual inheritance that will benefit your lineage for centuries to come. Now, I want to talk to you about the power of the blood of Jesus. There is no weapon in your spiritual arsenal more powerful than the blood of Jesus Christ. The Bible says in Revelation 12:1, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they did not love their lives to the death." The blood of Jesus is not just a theological concept. It is a spiritual reality. When you plead the blood of Jesus over your life, you are activating the most powerful force in the universe. That blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel. The blood of Abel cried out for vengeance, but the blood of Jesus cries out for mercy. That blood has the power to cleanse you from all unrighteousness. That blood has the power to break every curse. That blood has the power to heal every disease. That blood has the power to open every door. That blood has the power to silence every accuser. And so right now, wherever you are, I want you to plead the blood of Jesus over your life. Say, "I plead the blood of Jesus over my spirit, my soul, and my body. I plead the blood of Jesus over my mind, my emotions, and my will. I plead the blood of Jesus over my marriage, my children, and my family. I plead the blood of Jesus over my finances, my business, and my career. I plead the blood of Jesus over my ministry, my calling, and my destiny. And I decree that by the blood of Jesus, every battle I am facing today will end in testimony in Jesus' name. Now, can I tell you something about spiritual warfare? The devil is not afraid of your education. He's not afraid of your social status. He's not afraid of your physical strength, but he trembles when you mention the blood of Jesus. He trembles when you mention the name of Jesus. He trembles when you stand on the word of God. This is why many believers are defeated. They are fighting with human wisdom. They are fighting with intellectual arguments. They are fighting with emotional manipulation. But the Bible says our weapons are not carnal. They are mighty through God. And when you learn to fight with spiritual weapons, I prophesy that you will become unstoppable. Demons will flee at your presence. Sickness will live at your command. Poverty will evacuate at your decree. Death will reverse at your declaration. Let me give you another scriptural example. When Paul and Silas were in prison at midnight, they were in a battle. They had been beaten. They had been falsely accused. They had been imprisoned unjustly. But instead of complaining, instead of murmmoring, instead of blaming God, the Bible says they prayed and sang praises to God. And suddenly there was a great earthquake so that the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened and everyone's chains were loosed. You see, their battle ended in testimony. Not only were they delivered, but the jailer and his entire household were saved. Their midnight became their miracle hour. Their prison became their pullpit. Their chains became their testimony. And this is what I prophesy over your life today. Your midnight is about to turn into morning. Your prison is about to become your platform. Your chain is about to become your testimony. What the devil meant for evil, God is turning around for good. What was meant to destroy you is about to promote you. What was meant to kill you is about to establish you. What was meant to limit you is about to launch you into your next dimension. Now, there is one more thing I want to address before we go into intensive prayer. You must understand the importance of spiritual stamina. Many believers start the race well, but they don't finish. They begin to fight, but they grow weary. They start with faith, but they end in fear. And this is what the Bible warns us about in Galatians 6:9. And let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart. Your breakthrough is in your refusal to give up. Your testimony is in your determination to keep going. Your victory is in your decision to stand when everything around you is falling. The Bible says concerning Jesus in Hebrews 12:2 that for the joy that was set before him endured the cross despising the shame and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God. Jesus endured. He didn't quit when it was painful. He didn't quit when he was mocked. He didn't quit when he was betrayed. He didn't quit when he was crucified. He endured because he could see beyond the present pain to the future glory. And this is what you must do. You must look beyond your current battle and see your future testimony. You must look beyond your present pain and see your coming glory. I speak to someone who is about to give up. I speak to someone who is tired of fighting. I speak to someone who has said, "I can't do this anymore." The spirit of the Lord says to you, "Don't quit now. You are closer than you think. Your breakthrough is at the door. Your testimony is around the corner. Your victory is within reach. Just hold on a little longer. Just stand a little firmer. Just believe a little stronger. Now, we are going to go into prayer. And when we pray, we're not going to pray weak prayers. We're not going to pray religious prayers. We're going to pray militant prayers. We're going to engage in spiritual warfare. We're going to take authority over every force that has been assigned against your life. We're going to dismantle every altar that has been raised against your destiny. We are going to break every covenant that has been established in darkness. We're going to command every mountain to move. We're going to decree that every battle of today will end in testimony. So, lift up your hands right now. Don't be passive. Don't be casual. Engage your spirit. Open your mouth. Begin to pray in tonesues. If you have the gift of tongues, begin to decree the word of God. Begin to call forth your testimony. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace with boldness. I come not in my own righteousness, but in the righteousness of Jesus Christ. I come covered by his blood. I come carrying his authority. And father, I present before you every person who is hearing this word right now. I present before you every battle they are facing. Whether it is a battle of sickness, a battle of poverty, a battle of barness, a battle of delay, a battle of stagnation, a battle against their destiny. Father, I ask that your power will be released. Lord, I decree that every demonic orchestration is dismantled. Every satanic conspiracy is exposed and destroyed. Every evil altar that has been raised against the lives of your children, Lord, let fire fall from heaven and consume it. Every covenant with darkness, Lord, let the blood of Jesus nullify it. Every curse that has been spoken, Lord, let it be reversed. Every arrow that has been shot, Lord, let it return to sender. Father, I pray for those who are battling sickness in their bodies. Lord, you are Jehovah Rafa, the God who heals. I decree that every sickness, every disease, every infirmity, leave now in the name of Jesus. Cancer, leave. Diabetes leave. High blood pressure leave. Stroke be reversed. Heart disease be healed. Kidney failure be restored. Whatever the doctors have said, Lord, let your word override it. You said by the stripes of Jesus, we are healed. Therefore, I decree healing into every body. I decree strength into every organ. I decree restoration into every system. Let health flow like a river. Let life be restored in Jesus name. Father I pray for those who are in financial battles. Lord you are Jehovah Gyre the God who provides. I break every cause of poverty. I break every spirit of lack. I break every demon of debt. I command doors of financial breakthrough to open. I decree that withheld resources are released. I decree that stolen blessings are restored. I decree that delayed promotions are activated. I decree that every Joseph will come out of prison and be promoted to the palace. I decree that every business that has been struggling will experience divine turnaround. I decree that every investment that has failed will be recovered sevenfold. Let the wealth of the sinner be transferred to the righteous. Let provision come from unexpected sources. Let supernatural abundance manifest in Jesus name. Father, I pray for marriages that are in battle. Lord, I break every spirit of division. I break every spirit of adultery. I break every spirit of offense. I break every spirit of bitterness. I decree that love is restored. I decree that communication is restored. I decree that intimacy is restored. I decree that trust is restored. Let every third party agent be exposed and expelled. Let every demonic influence be broken. Let the glory of God fill every hole. Let peace reign. Let joy return. Let covenant love be reestablished in Jesus name. Father, I pray for those whose destinies have been under attack. Lord, I break every course of failure. I break every spirit of almost there. I break every demon of near success syndrome. I command every door that the enemy has shut to be opened by force. I decree that divine opportunities are manifesting. I decree that divine connections are being established. I decree that divine promotion is activated. Let every Joseph come out of prison. Let every Daniel be promoted in Babylon. Let every David be brought from the shipfold to the throne. Let destiny arise. Let purpose be fulfilled. Let potential be maximized in Jesus name. Father I take authority over the spirit of delay. Every delay in marriage be terminated now. Every delay in child birth be terminated now. Every delay in breakthrough be terminated now. Every delay in promotion be terminated now. Every delay in ministry be terminated now. I decree acceleration. I decree that what should have taken 10 years will happen in one year. What should have taken one year will happen in one month. What should have taken one month will happen in one day. Let divine speed be activated. Let supernatural acceleration manifest in Jesus name. Father I pray against every spirit of death. I command every spirit of premature death to leave. I break every evil covenant with the grave. I cancel every appointment with death. I decree long life. I decree that those who are here today will live to fulfill their days. They will not die prematurely. They will not be caught off in their prime. They will live to declare the works of the Lord. They will live to see their children's children. They will live to complete their assignment. Let the spirit of death be bound. Let the spirit of life be released in Jesus name. Father, I pray for those who are battling with fear, anxiety, depression, and mental oppression. Lord, I break every spirit of fear. I break every spirit of worry. I break every spirit of anxiety. I break every spirit of depression. I break every suicidal thought. I break every tormenting spirit. I decree peace. I decree joy. I decree hope. I decree clarity. I decree that the sound mind that you have given will manifest. Let every chemical imbalance in the brain be corrected. Let every emotional wound be healed. Let every traumatic memory be healed. Let divine peace that passes understanding guard their hearts and minds in Jesus name. Father I pray for those who are in battles in their ministries. Lord I break every spirit of discouragement. I break every spirit of opposition. I break every Jezebel spirit. I break every spirit of sabotage. I break every conspiracy against their ministries. I decree that what you have called them to do will be accomplished. I decree that no weapon formed against them will prosper. I decree that every tongue that rises against them in judgment will be condemned. I decree divine vindication. I decree divine protection. I decree divine provision. Let apostolic grace be multiplied. Let prophetic accuracy be increased. Let teaching anointing be enhanced. Let pastoral compassion be deepened. Let evangelistic fire be ignited in Jesus' name. Now I want you to begin to thank God. Begin to praise him for what he has done. Begin to worship him for the testimony that is coming. Don't wait until you see it with your physical eyes. Begin to celebrate it now in the spirit realm. Begin to dance. Begin to shout. Begin to rejoice. Your battle is over. Your victory is secured. Your testimony is guaranteed. I decree over your life before this day ends, you will receive a sign of your testimony. Before this week ends, you will see evidence of your breakthrough. Before this month ends, you will enter into a new dimension of glory. The Lord is about to do something in your life that will cause people to ask, "What has your God done for you?" And you will have a testimony to share. So, open your mouth right now and begin to thank him. Say, "Father, I thank you because my battle has ended in testimony. I thank you because victory is mine. I thank you because breakthrough is manifesting. I thank you because doors are opening. I thank you because healing is flowing. I thank you because provision is coming. I thank you because my destiny is being restored. I thank you because my family is being delivered. I thank you because my ministry is being elevated. Father, I thank you. I praise you. I worship you in Jesus mighty name. Amen and amen. Now go in the authority of Jesus Christ. Walk in the confidence that your battle has ended in testimony. Live in the expectation that God is about to do something magnificent in your life. And when your testimony manifest, not if, but when. Make sure you give God all the glory. Make sure you tell everyone what the Lord has done. Make sure you become a living witness of his power, his faithfulness, and his love. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. May the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen.
